# tenure intention

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](gmeow-tenureIntention.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureIntention>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The desire or intention the tenure records the agent as holding over its interval. Functional: one tenure, one mode. [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) tenure is carried by the [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) relator's own temporal scope (relators are time-indexed by construction); the tenure class exists for the intrinsic modes, whose adoption and abandonment would otherwise be invisible.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](gmeow-tenureIntention.md) from [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) to [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md), [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bind an [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) to the single intrinsic mode ([`Desire`](../classes/gmeow-Desire.md) or [`Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md)) whose holding over the interval it records.

### Avoid when

- Avoid pointing it at a [`gmeow:Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) (a relator already carries its own temporal scope) and avoid more than one mode per tenure; it is functional.

### How to use

- Point the tenure at exactly one [`gmeow:IntentionalMode`](../classes/gmeow-IntentionalMode.md); open and close the surrounding [`gmeow:duringInterval`](gmeow-duringInterval.md) to record adoption and abandonment rather than mutating or deleting the mode ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### Examples

- ex:resolveTenure [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](gmeow-tenureIntention.md) ex:planToShip.
